## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive; leadership concentrated in Technology (Top 5: 3/5 tech) which creates a narrow leadership tilt and offsets clear directional conviction.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology lead: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +20.59% | 1M: +40.84%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: NUE (1W: +9.40% | 1M: +30.18%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +8.60% | 1M: -2.42%) RECOVERY. Energy showing upside: SLB (1W: +6.63% | 1M: +8.21%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication weak: CHTR (1W: -23.87% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA broadly pressured. Healthcare lagging: DHR (1W: -8.99% | 1M: -5.09%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -5.18%) BELOW TREND. Industrials mixed to weak: HON (1W: -8.73% | 1M: -5.59%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -13.30% | 1M: -17.74%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +20.59% | 1M: +40.84%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND, NUE (1W: +9.40% | 1M: +30.18%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology) — concentration risk present.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CHTR (1W: -23.87% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -13.30% | 1M: -17.74%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -13.05% | 1M: +7.17%) CORRECTION, RTX (1W: -11.28% | 1M: -10.64%) BELOW TREND, TMO (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -4.29%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Industrials/Defense and select Materials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: AMD (1W: +24.94%), TXN (1W: +20.59%), INTC (1W: +20.50%), QCOM (1W: +9.29%), DOW (1W: +8.60%) RECOVERY (1M down). Major divergence flagged: multiple large caps show 1W vs 1M disagreement — treat as tactical, not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is leading but narrow; AAPL (1W: +0.31% | 1M: +7.30%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +14.44%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +3.27% | 1M: +16.56%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: tech part of the 5/11 positive sectors — rotation risk if breadth fails to broaden.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are mixed/lagging 1W; JPM (1W: -0.65% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -2.40% | 1M: +1.48%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -3.29% | 1M: +0.45%) CORRECTION — look for confirmation before shifting style exposure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare weak on the week but with pockets of strength; UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND while JNJ (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -5.18%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -4.65% | 1M: -3.53%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: part of the 6/11 sectors that are negative this week.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain neutral posture; favor selective exposure to tech names showing clear ABOVE TREND momentum (AMD, TXN, INTC) and high-quality healthcare strength (UNH), while reducing exposure to the worst weekly performers in Communication and Defense (CHTR, LMT, RTX). Style: Growth-leaning within a neutral regime but leadership is narrow — monitor for breadth expansion before broadening positions.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND — follow volume and dispersion; UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND on strong earnings flow. BEARISH: CHTR (1W: -23.87% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND on heavy downside sentiment; ISRG headline risk (-70) if price action confirms.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology and Materials if leadership broadens beyond top names (watch chip suppliers). BEARISH: Communication and Healthcare if negative sentiment (CHTR, ISRG, ABBV) continues and adds selling pressure.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA for follow-through on recent highs to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; AAPL holding 1M trend would validate tech breadth; UNH sustaining post-earnings momentum to confirm healthcare strength; CHTR must reclaim short-term support to avert deeper downside.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
UNP (+55): Record operating income noted; UNP (1W: +6.99% | 1M: +11.34%) ABOVE TREND — price action confirming sentiment. ADBE (+80): buyback headline bullish but ADBE 1W/1M not in core snapshot — watch for confirmation in price. NFLX (+60): buyback talk; verify price follow-through before expanding exposure.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CHTR (-60): Charter hit by heavy negative headlines; CHTR (1W: -23.87% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. ISRG (-70): recall risk flagged; confirm with price weakness. V (-50) / MA (-50): regulatory headline; V (1W: -2.40% | 1M: +1.48%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -3.29% | 1M: +0.45%) CORRECTION — watch payments names for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership as narrow tech strength conflicts with weak breadth. AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND and TXN (1W: +20.59% | 1M: +40.84%) ABOVE TREND are showing the strongest relative strength. Key risk is major divergence across large caps (CHTR, LMT, ISRG headlines and CORRECTIONs in payment names) — monitor breadth and sentiment for confirmation.
